blind.description: A stylized, rounded flowering bush composed of layered leafy clumps and scattered small blossoms. The leaves have a painted texture transitioning from light vibrant green at the top to deep dark green near the base and interior shadows. Dotted around the foliage are small, pale yellow flowers with orange-yellow centers. The bush forms a self-contained rounded mound resting directly on the ground without any separate base or soil patch.
blind.from_above: A roughly circular green foliage cluster peppered with small pale yellow flowers, casting a soft shadow to the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 to 3 feet tall), with a similar diameter of around 2.5 to 3 feet across.
